content:
Result is a tuple of precursors: first is a complex amine with carbamate, second is sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl. So step 1: target -> precursors A and B.

We need to build route with 6 reactions. So we will continue retrosynthesis on each precursor using next templates in order.

We have list of templates order: 20810, 2895, 1914397, 1914398, 1914399, 74054.

We already used 20810. Next apply 2895 to one of the precursors. Likely to disconnect the carbamate? Let's apply to the first precursor: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Use apply_template 2895.
